list.title: Support
list.intro: Your organisation’s support tickets: follow replies, answer directly from here and open a new ticket when something is not working.
list.caption: Support tickets of your organisation

empty.openText: Everything you sent us is answered or solved. Open a new ticket when something is not working.
empty.solvedText: Solved and closed tickets will be listed here.
empty.allText: Your organisation has not contacted support from the dashboard or the contact form yet.

list.limited: Showing the {limit} most recently updated tickets.
list.readOnly: Your role can view tickets. Opening and answering tickets needs a role with support write access (every role except Read only).
list.unavailableText: The ticket tables are not applied to this database yet (migration 0015). Until then, reach us through the contact form; every request is answered by e-mail.

form.title: New ticket
form.intro: Describe what is not working or what you need. Every ticket is answered by e-mail and stays visible here for your whole organisation.
form.subject: Subject
form.subjectHint: One line that says what it is about, {min}–{max} characters.
form.priorityHint: Your estimate helps us sort the queue; our support team may adjust it.
form.messageHint: What happened, what did you expect, since when? Site names, event names and screenshots help — {min}–{max} characters.
form.attachmentsHint: Up to {count} files, {size} each: images, PDF, text, CSV, JSON, Word, Excel or an e-mail file (.eml).
form.selected: {count, plural, =1 {1 file selected} other {# files selected}}
form.requester: The ticket is opened in the name of {name} ({email}); replies are sent to this address.

suggestions.title: Maybe this already helps
suggestions.intro: Articles from Tracking Knowledge that match what you are typing. They open in a new tab.
suggestions.empty: No matching article yet — keep typing or simply open the ticket.
suggestions.typing: Type a few words in the subject or message to see matching articles.

detail.merged: This ticket was merged into ticket {number}. The conversation continues there.

reply.title: Reply
reply.bodyHint: {min}–{max} characters. Your reply is sent to our support team; you will get every answer by e-mail as well.
reply.reopens: This ticket is solved. Sending a message reopens it.
reply.pendingHint: Our support team is waiting for your answer.
reply.closedBlocked: This ticket cannot receive messages any more. Open a new ticket if you need further help.

solve.title: Mark ticket as solved?
solve.description: Ticket {number} will be marked as solved. You can still reply afterwards, which reopens it.

csat.title: How did we do?
csat.intro: Your ticket is solved. Rate the support you received — one answer per ticket, visible to our support team.
csat.rated: Your organisation rated this ticket {score} out of 5 on {date}.
csat.disabled: Satisfaction surveys are switched off at the moment.

notices.created: Your ticket was opened. We will answer by e-mail and here.
notices.replied: Your reply was added to the ticket.
notices.reopened: Your reply was added and the ticket was reopened.
notices.solved: The ticket was marked as solved.

errors.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do that.
errors.not_found: That ticket does not exist or belongs to another organisation.
errors.invalid_state: That is not possible in the ticket’s current state.
errors.attachments: Some attachments were refused; nothing was sent. Remove them and try again.
errors.csat_disabled: Satisfaction surveys are switched off at the moment.
errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.subject: Enter a subject of {min}–{max} characters.
